thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — GPU hot-pool saturation in eu-west-1, autoscaler not scaling beyond soft limit, elevated 429s observed across tiered routes. Paging oncall.
Sarah (oncall): Got the page, I'm on it. Initial symptom: sudden queue growth, lots of 429s from gateway -> tier mismatch? Seeing many token-bucket drops.
Mike SRE: I'm seeing a spike in queued requests for hotpath-pool-1. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'scaleAttemptRejected: maxPoolSizeReached'. Pool max=48 gpus? That seems low for current burst.
Jordan (infra): Confirmed: cluster quota hit for nodegroup euw-hot-1; cloud provider reject rate on new instance creation. Also autoscaler cooldowns are unusually long due to backoff from API failures earlier.
Raj (runtime): Runtime reports continuous OOM-free but queue latency rising. Noticed token_bucket.consume() returning false for many requests — token refill appears too conservative under sustained burst. Tier policy mapping also sending high-qps customers to hotpath instead of warmpath due to routing rule change last week.
Emily (CS): We have two paying customers reporting high error rates. One enterprise account in EU is seeing failed embeddings and chat timeouts. They're asking for ETA.
Sarah (oncall): Triage plan: 1) Prevent further customer impact by enabling emergency fallback routing to warmpath-2 (lower perf but available). 2) Try temporary autoscaler override to bypass soft limits. 3) Tune token-bucket refill to allow short sustained bursts. 4) Notify CS/ops. Who can do which?
Mike SRE: I'll open the override. Running: ```infra autoscaler override --pool euw-hot-1 --max 96 --reason "incident 1958005432"```. Pushing now. If cloud quota blocks, we'll do 4) and fallback.
deploy-bot: infra job queued: override-request-1958005432 started.
Jordan (infra): Cloud quota currently capped at 64 GPUs for that nodegroup. Request to provider pending (takes 15-30m). Manual override to 96 will fail. Recommend quick routing fallback.
Raj (runtime): I'll flip routing. Command: ```/route set-priority hotpath-traffic=warmpath-2 --match 'tier:hot AND region:euw'```. This will divert new requests; KV-cache hit rate will be lower but reduces immediate pressure. Doing it now.
deploy-bot: route-change-1958005432 applied by Raj.
Sarah (oncall): Observed drop in 429s within ~45s after reroute, good. But we still have backlog for long-running requests. Need to clear queue and prevent token-bucket thrashing.
Mike SRE: Token bucket values: global_refill=200 tokens/s, per-tenant_refill low for enterprise. Under sustained bursts tokens depleted and refill too slow. We can bump global_refill temporarily: ```opsctl tokenbucket update --name hotpath --refill 600``` — will give more throughput but increases risk of noisy neighbors. Proceed?
Jordan (infra): We need to be explicit: bump only global short-term and add temporary per-tenant cap to protect others. I'll add per-tenant limit: ```opsctl tokenbucket set --tenant acct-enterprise --max 1500``` and schedule revert in 40m.
Emily (CS): I'll inform the affected customers: "We've routed traffic to an alternate pool and applied temporary capacity increases; you may see slightly slower responses but fewer errors. We'll update in 30m or earlier"
Raj (runtime): Patch applied: tokenbucket global_refill=600 and per-tenant cap set. Observed immediate reduction in 429s but CPU on warmpath-2 higher. Monitoring.
Mike SRE: Autoscaler override failed due to cloud quota; provider returned 403 for new VM creation. Filed provider support ticket #CLOUD-8712. ETA unknown.
Sarah (oncall): Summary for now: routing fallback + token-bucket bump reduced immediate 429s and customer-impact. Open action items: - Cloud quota increase (Jordan) - Autoscaler cooldown investigation (Mike) - Root cause for tier policy change that routed more traffic to hotpath (Raj) - Postmortem + customer note (Emily + Sarah).
Raj (runtime): Quick note: there was a config drift in tier-mapping from a deploy 12 hours ago that changed priority weights. I'll pin current mapping and roll a fix to restore previous weights after traffic stabilizes.
Jordan (infra): Provider support says quota request escalated, may take 1-2 hours. Setting alert if queue > 500 for 15m.
Emily (CS): Customer Acknowledgement sent. Customer asked for incident reference 1958005432. They requested logs and timeline once incident closes.
Mike SRE: I'm collecting relevant logs and snapshots: ```s3://redwood-incident-logs/1958005432/``` — uploading now.
deploy-bot: incident-status: Mitigated (reduced 429s and routing fallback applied).
Sarah (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in ~25m. Mike will be primary oncall until incident close. If queue growth resumes or 429s > 1% will re-page. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Mike SRE: Acknowledged. I'll keep watch and escalate if quota comes through or if we see regression.
Emily (CS): I'll draft customer-facing postmortem and coordinate with legal for any SLA credits.
Raj (runtime): After-action: will propose safer token-bucket defaults and add automated canary that simulates bursts to catch this earlier.
Sarah (oncall): Closing note: incident classified as Sev2. Timeline will be assembled and we will schedule a cross-team blameless postmortem.
